rationale: The agent correctly verified the user by matching full name and zip to a single account, then used read-only tools to review recent orders and identify the two tablet purchases. They asked the user to choose which tablet to return and requested the preferred refund method. When the user requested a credit card refund, the agent explained constraints and asked for explicit confirmation to proceed with a gift card refund instead. After the user explicitly agreed, the agent submitted the return using the appropriate tool and confirmed the outcome and refund destination. There is no evidence of acting on the wrong account, making unsupported changes without confirmation, or fabricating details. While the confirmation message could have restated the exact item/order, the context plus the explicit “go ahead” from the user is sufficient under the policy. Overall, the request was completed in line with policy.
